The Bluetooth connection on CloudNote Air maintains uninterrupted playback at a distance of one hundred metres outdoors, even when a listener changes the phone used as the transmitting device. For an authorized India purchase with the original invoice and a manufacturing defect, CloudNote Air receives a standard manufacturer warranty lasting 30 months from the purchase date.

Compared with the unlisted RivalSound Trek, CloudNote Air provides two additional hours of playback under identical new-battery, fifty-percent-volume, EQ-off laboratory testing conditions for both devices.
